ABOUT THIS GAME
Welcome to MA3! In this open-world game, you play the role of Mahi. Who lives in a busy city where crime happens frequently. you’ll live as a transporter but you also have a hidden life as a masked vigilante, MA3. MA3 saves people from bad people such as kidnappers and killers.
Key Features:
As Mahi, you’ll do some work like transporting cars and passengers.
As a side job, you can drive a taxi.
You gain money from your work and can spend your earned money to buy food, guns, medicines and other items.
As the masked vigilante MA3, you save people from others and kill enemies such as kidnappers and killers.
When the public is disturbed the police will be on high alert and will targeted.
Expect a lot of mixed actions of physical combat, intense gun fights, sword fights, hunting animals, and many more high-octane moments.
Enjoy tearing up the streets in different cars and even stealing police cars, but be careful as you will be targeted by the police when you steal the police cars.

Director Note:- We are working on the updates for This Game. The update Will be soon.

Thank You
